summary: Sets flag bits 1 and 2 in the state dword at this+0x3C (dword index this[15]) by OR-ing the constant 6. Single-expression body with no reads, guards, globals, or callees. Invoked by three flag-driven loop/conditional dispatchers (004A3390, 004A3440, 004A34A0); prelabel marks it a structural twin of the BitClear at 0054C190.

local_names.this: owning object carrying the state dword at byte offset +0x3C

operations.description: OR-accumulate the mask 6 into the state dword this[15] at byte offset +0x3C, raising flag bits 1 and 2
Only the two state flag bits at +0x3C are raised; no other field is read or modified and no guard gates the write
void function returning no value; the three callers 004A3390, 004A3440 and 004A34A0 invoke it from their per-element flag paths

clean_pseudocode: this[15] |= 6;  // set flag bits 1 and 2 at this+0x3C
unresolved: Semantics of the two flag bits at this+0x3C are unknown; only that this function raises them, not which behavior they gate
